notes.title: KEABE - Patch Update
notes.content:
Big thanks to everyone who has played or reviewed KEABE.

This patch includes the following updates:
• Player profile system
• Updated player damage indicator
• New knitted/fabric materials for characters
• Ammo shell ejection effect
• New throwable explosive
• Return-warp discs added in Sewer City

Happy trails!

notes.title: KEABE - Patch Update
notes.content:
This patch includes the following updates and fixes:

New Visual Effects:

 Player damage effects.
 Sentry gun damage effects.


Default Settings:

 Default splatter value set to 50.


Bug Fix:

 Resolved an issue where entering Single Player mode after exiting Multiplayer required a game restart.


Platform Support:

 Added support for macOS.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
KEABE Update Patch Notes

What’s New:

Added online chat for player communication during gameplay.

Introduced a game info console to display key gameplay details.

Added single-player mode and online multiplayer mode.

Added bots to enhance gameplay experience in both modes.

Full input support for both keyboard and gamepad.

Enhanced gameplay with killfeed, 3D sound, all-new SFX, and improved animations.

Added new items, including a backpack, and improved character controls.

Added a new map: Sewer City.

Updated King of the Hill mode to unlock only at the end of the 3rd round.

Introduced warp points for seamless navigation across the game world.

Upgraded visuals with additional effects and rebuilt the game for better performance and stability.

Fixed Unity editor crash bug.


Development Updates:

KEABE is now published by Killerapp.Gamestudio Oy Ltd.

The development team includes:

M Ida Wahlström as Audiovisual Engineer.

Arttu Pekkala as Programming Engineer.
